## Objective

Produce a coherent shared release, checked neutral Template and exact active-depot adoption.

## Scope

- Reader build
- Package pins and Template distribution
- Active depot adoption

## Entry conditions

- All source changes, focused owner regressions, test definitions and guidance are settled.

## Exit criteria

- Build/source/package identities and Template mappings agree.
- Active depot adoption is current and real products remain untouched.

## Risks

- Watcher publication and source edits can race; use existing hold/check/apply/recovery controls.
- Changing any source after this phase invalidates affected qualification and requires re-packaging.

### Risks

- Any changed reader-bound input returns to the freeze/build gate; do not preserve a stale build claim.
- Only non-reader-bound generated inventory may be finalized after the build; no automatic npm install occurs at reader launch.

### Acceptance criteria

- Actual build/source/schema/lock/notices/owner inputs agree and the complete packaged reader validates; generated assets are never hand edited.
- The checked Template is current and neutral, with no learned records, destination authority, environments/models or real-product writes; source/package pins match the released inventory.

### Planned verification

- Under separately authorized build/dependency scope, use the pinned BUILD.md toolchain, npm run build and npm run package:runtime, then verify exact build/asset identities.
- Use existing watcher coordination and template_update.py check/apply/check for the registered Template; verify package admission and mapping equality after publication.
